 JEE Main 2027: 7.04 lakh pay fees as Nov 22 deadline nears
 By News Desk 
 Monday, 16 November 2026, 19:52:39 IST 
 0 
 Facebook WhatsApp X Telegram 
 The National Testing Agency (NTA) confirmed on Monday that 7,04,316 applicants have completed the registration and fee payment for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main 2027 Session-1. 
 The agency urged remaining aspirants to finish their formalities before the November 22 deadline, noting that only seven days remain before the submission window officially closes. 
 According to an official NTA update on social media platform X, a total of 9,05,144 candidates have registered on the portal so far. 
 However, over two lakh registered aspirants have yet to finalize their fee payments, prompting the testing agency to issue an urgent reminder against leaving applications halfway. 
 In its social media post, the NTA outlined four simple steps for candidates: upload documents, fill in personal details, complete the fee payment, and download the final confirmation page. 
 Earlier this week, the agency instructed candidates to log in exclusively using their own DigiLocker, JanParichay, or MeriPehchaan credentials to prevent biometric and identity verification discrepancies during later stages. 
 Officials also recommended that applicants complete a DigiLocker Re-KYC before filling out the form so the system automatically fetches their most updated personal records. 
 Additionally, the NTA released a clear advisory to help domestic and international aspirants accurately select their nationality and Aadhaar categories during the registration process. 
 The guidelines specify that Indian citizens, including Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) holding an Aadhaar card, must apply strictly under the Indian Nationals category. 
 Meanwhile, foreign citizens and Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholders must select the Foreign Nationals category when submitting their online applications. 
 Finally, NRIs holding an Indian passport without an Aadhaar card must choose the dedicated category for NRIs without Aadhaar to ensure smooth verification.
